evidence.quote: Overall, liquidity is adequate by most measures, in most markets, and most of the time.
Regulatory changes, even those that may have reduced market liquidity, likely have enhanced financial stability on balance.
In light of these changes and the evolving structure of financial markets, it will be important to monitor and continue to analyze the state of market liquidity.
